def sw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); E=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); F=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8); best=(0,0,0)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            E[i,j]=max(E[i,j-1]+ge, H[i,j-1]+go)
            F[i,j]=max(F[i-1,j]+ge, H[i-1,j]+go)
            d=H[i-1,j-1]+B62.get((ai,b[j-1]),-1)
            v=max(0,d,E[i,j],F[i,j]); H[i,j]=v
            P[i,j]= 0 if v==0 else (1 if v==d else (2 if v==E[i,j] else 3))
            if v>best[0]: best=(v,i,j)
    s,i,j=best; ident=0; alen=0
    while i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]!=0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==1:
            alen+=1; ident+= (a[i-1]==b[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==2: alen+=1; j-=1
        else: alen+=1; i-=1
    return s, 100*ident/alen, alen

def seqof(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=25).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
